english.title: Attempt to ascertain person for whom vote cast or communicate information at postal ballot
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person attending proceedings in connection with the receipt of ballot papers for persons voting by post, attempted to

(A)_[ascertain at those proceedings]_
(B)_[communicate information obtained at those proceedings with respect to]_

the

(C)_[candidate for whom]_
(D)_[registered political party towards the return of whose candidates]_

a vote was given in a particular ballot paper
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(4)(d) and (6) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person attending proceedings in connection with the receipt of ballot papers for persons voting by post
attempted to ascertain at those proceedings or communicate information obtained at those proceedings with respect to
the candidate for whom or registered political party towards the return of whose candidates
a vote was given in a particular ballot paper

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Option D relates to an election of the London members of the London Assembly, as per subsection 66(7) of the Act.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
